stem.text: Which statement supports the fact that mature plant cells contain organelles that carry out the same role as lysosomes?

A.text: A range of hydrolytic enzymes can be found within mature plant vacuoles.

B.text: Glycogen, found within vesicles, can be hydrolysed to glucose molecules.

C.text: Double membrane-bound vesicles are formed from plant Golgi bodies.

D.text: Vesicles, formed from the cell surface membrane, contain enzymes.
